items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I had a ball playing with Milt.

ctx.x: In 1968 you took a tour of Europe with Milt Buckner. How did that come about?

Oh, it was good. Milt is one of the finest guys that can take any kind of thing and laugh it off. He used to -- amaze me -- he would laugh if you dropped a pencil on the floor. He was a fun cat. I don't care what you do -- you could say, hey man, look at that bird flying by and he would break out and laugh. I mean laughin' -- no g kidelin' around -- And a musician; such a musician. I had a ball playing with Milt. What was that bass player, played with Louis Armstrong ... Arvell Shaw. He and George Wein sent us to…
Was that the first time you were in Europe?
